text: {"lessons":["Selling a position just because it is above my average cost can lock in gains without improving the portfolio; base trades on future prospects and my overall allocation.","Buying back into stocks at higher prices after selling winners is not automatically a mistake, but I should size purchases deliberately and avoid letting regret or past prices drive decisions.","With no reliable signal in recent price changes, I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and follow a consistent, diversified plan."]}
